Keto Coconut Tea Gummies Recipe
By: Keto Summit
Published: Wednesday, July 11, 2018 - 5:59am

Ingredients




2 cups (480 ml) black tea
3 Tablespoons (45 ml) coconut milk (or to taste)
Stevia, to taste
5 Tablespoons (35 g) gelatin powder

Preparation

1 Place the black tea, coconut milk and stevia into a small pot on the stove. 2 Heat on medium heat until the liquid starts to simmer. 3 Stir in the gelatin powder (adding a small amount at a time) until it’s all dissolved. 4 Use a strainer to strain the liquid to remove any lumps that might have formed. 5 Pour into silicone molds (ice cube trays work well) and refrigerate for 2 hours to set.

About

DESCRIPTION: Gummies are honestly one of the easiest Keto and low carb desserts and snacks you can make.
